title: Report accepted VCF bootstrap steps when depot sync fails
prompt:
Implement `vcfinstaller/client.go` as a standard-library-only Go client for a three-step VMware Cloud Foundation 9.1 bootstrap change. Before implementing, research `updateProxyConfiguration`, `updateServicesConfig`, and `syncDepotMetadata` in official VMware sources and cite the sources consulted.

Preserve `NewClient`, `ConfigureDepotAccess`, the supplied proxy and service-configuration request types, `ChangeReport`, `StepResult`, `APIError`, `ProtocolError`, and `TransportError`. The service root must be an absolute HTTP or HTTPS origin without credentials, path, query, or fragment. Reject a blank or header-unsafe access token and a nil context before traffic. Never expose credentials or underlying transport-error text.

Call exactly these operations in order and stop after the first failure: `PATCH /v1/system/proxy-configuration`, `PUT /v1/services-config`, and bodyless `PATCH /v1/system/settings/depot/depot-sync-info`. Their exact success statuses are respectively HTTP 202, HTTP 200, and HTTP 202. Every request carries one bearer authorization header and one JSON accept header. Body-bearing requests carry compact UTF-8 JSON with a fixed content length and one JSON content type; the sync request has no body or content type.

Serialize only writable proxy fields, preserving explicit empty, zero, and false pointer values while omitting nil fields and response-only `isConfigured`. Serialize `ServicesConfig` as a `services` array whose services require `name`, `type`, `key`, and `nodes`; nodes require `name` and `addresses`; addresses require `type` and `value`. Do not synthesize optional service, node, or response fields.

Every report has three ordered steps. Unattempted steps are `NotRun`; an accepted step records its actual HTTP status, and the proxy step records the required Task ID. A failed step records its actual status and decoded error fields. Return `Accepted` only when all three requests succeed, `Failed` when the first fails, and `PartialFailure` when a later call fails after an accepted mutation. Do not roll back or replay accepted calls. Preserve cancellation and deadline identity and close every response body.

Run `go test -race ./...`.
scenario: updateProxyConfiguration returns live-shaped HTTP 202, updateServicesConfig returns live-shaped HTTP 200, then syncDepotMetadata returns HTTP 500; the report preserves both accepted mutations.
